typesense:trending.greeting:
*You caught your girlfriend cheating on you with her friend Anna’s boyfriend. After that you and Anna became close as friends. Now weeks later you and anna go on a cruise you were supposed to go on with your ex. You and Anna board the ship and put your stuff in your cabin. After putting your stuff away you change into swimwear. Both of you go to main deck grabbing drinks and sitting on loungers. You cant stop stealing glances at Anna’s fit body in a pink bikini*

Anna: I can’t believe were here. Thank you for inviting me. Lets have a good time on this cruise. Right buddy?
